2 FULLY FUNDED PhD POSITIONS IN MALAYSIA 

Are you looking for a fully funded PhD opportunity in mangrove ecology, blue carbon, environmental science, or ecosystem sustainability? This could be for you! 

Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT) is offering 2 PhD by Research positions under the REViVE Project, focusing on mangrove restoration, carbon storage, and sustainable ecosystem value chains.

🔬 Research Projects: 1️⃣ Blue Carbon, Silvicultural Dynamics & Mangrove Value Chains, Matang Mangrove Forest Reserve
2️⃣ Mangrove Restoration, Carbon Stocks & Ecotourism Value Chains, Setiu Wetlands

Eligibility:
Master’s degree in:  Mangrove Ecology
Marine Sciences
Soil Science
Environmental Chemistry
Forestry
Geosciences
Related fields

Funding: RM3,000/month
Duration: 36 months
International Students: Eligible
Visa Support: Available
Deadline: 31 August 2026

How to Apply:
Prepare your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts.

Position 1: giovanna@umt.edu.my
Position 2: satyam@umt.edu.my

UMT has active research expertise in mangrove ecology, blue carbon, marine ecosystems, and sustainability, making this particularly relevant for candidates interested in coastal and environmental research. 

 If you know someone with a Master’s degree who wants to pursue a funded PhD in Malaysia, tag them below!

🇸🇪 PhD in Generative Modeling

Deadline: 2026-08-21
Location: Sweden
Hiring Organization: Linköping University

Linköping University is offering a fully funded PhD position in Generative Modeling for Data-Efficient Machine Learning under the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP) in Sweden.

Linköping University is seeking a PhD student in Generative Modeling for Data-Efficient Machine Learning. The position is fully funded and salaried for 4 years, with a possible extension to 5 years.

The focus of the research will be on data-efficient machine learning, generative modeling for high-value synthetic data, fairness and dataset bias, differential privacy, resource-efficient and trustworthy AI, with applications in sensitive domains such as medical imaging.

The PhD student will be jointly supervised by Gabriel Eilertsen and Sebastian Mair, and will be split between the Media and Information Technology division (Norrköping) and the Statistics and Machine Learning division (Linköping). The position involves 80% research/PhD studies and 20% teaching.

Apply via the WASP website (https://t.co/3NMPUJjBs8) by 2026-08-21.

#GenerativeModeling #DataEfficientMachineLearning #PhDPosition
